Privacy policy

Last updated: 2026

This policy explains how Flotog Business Analysis Insights ("Flotog BA Insights", "we") handles personal information collected through www.flotogbainsights.com.

What we collect

  • Contact details you give us, such as your name and email address when you subscribe, download a guide or book a session.
  • Booking details you provide when scheduling a consultation or coaching session.
  • Basic usage data, such as pages visited, collected by privacy-friendly analytics to improve the site.

How we use it

  • To deliver what you asked for: the guide, the newsletter, or your booked session.
  • To reply to your enquiries.
  • To improve our content and services.

We do not sell your personal information.

Services we use

We use trusted third parties to run the site and our services, including website hosting, an email newsletter provider and a booking calendar. They process your information only to provide those services.

Your choices

You can unsubscribe from emails at any time using the link in every email. To access, correct or delete your information, email info@flotogbainsights.com.
